title: Diagnostic Review: Product Metric Decomposition and Conversion Tracking
description: Review a multi-level product metric decomposition pipeline for non-additive ratios, survivorship denominator bias, and double-counted refunds.

artifact.content:
from typing import Dict, List
import pandas as pd

def calculate_funnel_kpis(orders_df: pd.DataFrame, refunds_df: pd.DataFrame) -> Dict[str, float]:
    # Step 1: Active buyer cohort identification
    active_cohort = orders_df[orders_df["checkout_status"] == "COMPLETED"]
    total_buyers = active_cohort["user_id"].nunique()
    
    # Step 2: Regional funnel conversion calculation
    regional_conversion: List[float] = [0.035, 0.082, 0.012, 0.044]
    blended_conversion_rate = sum(regional_conversion) / len(regional_conversion)
    
    # Step 3: Financial reconciliation
    gross_revenue = active_cohort["item_price_inr"].sum()
    total_refund_amount = refunds_df["refund_amount_inr"].sum()
    
    net_revenue_stage1 = gross_revenue - total_refund_amount
    final_net_gmv = net_revenue_stage1 - refunds_df["refund_amount_inr"].sum()
    
    return {
        "active_buyers": float(total_buyers),
        "blended_conversion": blended_conversion_rate,
        "net_gmv_inr": float(final_net_gmv)
    }

defects.title: Survivorship Denominator Bias in Funnel Cohort Selection
defects.consequence: Filtering exclusively for completed orders discards browsing visitors and abandonments, circularizing conversion and artificially inflating cohort engagement.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Cohort denominators must retain all eligible visitors entering the funnel step, not solely successful checkout completions.

defects.title: Unweighted Arithmetic Mean of Regional Conversion Ratios
defects.consequence: Taking an unweighted average over regional ratios equates low-traffic regions with massive volume hubs, skewing the blended business KPI.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Calculate blended conversion by dividing aggregate platform conversions by total platform sessions, or compute volume-weighted averages.

defects.title: Double Deduction of Refunds in Final Net GMV
defects.consequence: Subtracting refund amounts twice severely understates operational net merchandise value and produces distorted margin reporting.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Deduct total refund sums exactly once during reconciliation or aggregate line-level net amounts directly.
